install_house3d_package: run pip install to install the House3D gym environment package with numpy and gym dependencies
review_setup_config: review the House3D setup.py package configuration including name, version, and install_requires
summarize_package_metadata: summarize the House3D package metadata including version 1.0.0 and required dependencies
refactor_package_dependencies: refactor the House3D setup.py to add or remove install_requires dependencies like gym or numpy
build_package_data: build the House3D package data configuration to include objrender.so and metadata CSV files
